To keep your AcmeBrew kettle in good condition, descale it every month if you live in a hard water area. Fill it halfway with water, add two tablespoons of citric acid, bring it to the boil and leave it for thirty minutes before rinsing it thoroughly. Never immerse the base in water, and wipe the outside with a damp cloth only. The removable filter at the spout can be rinsed under the tap whenever you notice limescale building up. If the kettle switches off before the water boils, descaling almost always fixes it, and the auto shut off feature will keep working as designed afterwards.
